Changes: selected component records; converted grains to grams and renamed
fields for MX Shooting Calculator; excluded possible existing matches and
packaging duplicates. Source lengths and uncertainty descriptions are retained
in notes; the active length field remains unknown. BCs are copied as recorded,
without fitting or independent verification. Construction, lead-free status
and expansion limits are not established by this import.

The adapted collection is shared under CC BY-SA 4.0, without additional
restrictions. The data is provided as found, without warranty, and its reuse
does not imply endorsement by ChamberSim Reloaded or any manufacturer.

The independent app code remains MIT OR Apache-2.0. No ChamberSim program code,
original Gordon's Reloading Tool database or external reference database is
included in this data collection.
